data.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-recall-result.md documenting the RECALL_RESULT and CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT signals emitted by inference-recall-replay.sh.

## Why
The harness needs a machine-readable contract that the completion-verifier (epic closure gate) can reference. Follows the same pattern as coverage-harness-output.md.

## Sections required (per T5 structural test)
- ## Signal Name
- ## Emitter
- ## Parser (completion-verifier SC4 gate)
- ## Output Schema (RECALL_RESULT JSON schema + CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT JSON schema)
- ## SC4 Gate Semantics (pass when recall_all>=0.5, recall_holdout>=0.7, precision>=0.5; fail path; CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT path)
- ## Invocation example

## Content
Document both signals:
1. RECALL_RESULT: {signal, recall_all, recall_holdout, precision, corpus_size, holdout_size, all_passed, thresholds}
2. CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT: {signal, corpus_size, minimum_required}

## AC: T5 structural tests pass after this task
data.title: GREEN: create RECALL_RESULT signal contract doc at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-recall-result.md
